items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, he had a good band, no question about it.

ctx.x: Yeah, he had a good band, no question about it. He had a good band. Yes, I remember. His band worked there, Rodriguez did his work for (unintelligible). Some way, he got away from New York for one reason or another, or he got lucky. (Unintelligible) came to me and said, I want your band. I say, I still got one more year to go. I think I was (inaudible), or Columbia, one of them. I got one more year to go on my contract but (inaudible). And the record they made, they made live right there at the Palladium.
All right, so they made about two or three albums.
